description: Codex P1 on PR #1538 (merged). .github/workflows/corpus-drift-check.yml compares develop and published-results with a SYMMETRIC 'git diff --name-only FETCH_HEAD HEAD'. Per docs/operations/results-phase-2-runbook.md the supported Phase 2 flow has community PRs merging DIRECTLY into published-results, adding bundles plus a regenerated inventory without necessarily landing on develop. Those published-only additions show up as drift, so after the first community merge the canary stays permanently red, cannot distinguish a missed develop mirror from legitimate branch-ahead content, and its remediation text recommends running the mirror - which would DELETE the community contribution. Verified the finding is real by reading the runbook flow; the canary as merged only ever ran against a corpus with no community-only bundles, which is why it looked correct.

preserves.behavior: Still fires when develop is genuinely ahead - that is the leak this canary exists to catch
